metadata.description: Feature library: categories, features (with their design rules) and the shared vocabulary. Bump the version on every change; the server refuses a changed file with an unchanged version.

externals.name: Camera
externals.description: Camera or other device producing a video feed (with its audio).

externals.name: External Source
externals.description: Remote or third-party feed arriving at the facility.

externals.name: External Destination
externals.description: Device or system receiving a feed from the facility (programme out, monitor wall, distribution).

references.label: SDP / address (RTP, Raw UDP, TSoIP, MBTS, ATSC 3.0, 2022-6, 2022-7, 2110)
SRT / RIST party
references.source: remote party name, e.g. venue-truck-1 (address/port: receiver SRT session)

references.label: ZIXI stream
references.source: Zixi stream id / broadcaster, e.g. venue-feed-1

references.label: RTMP(S) stream
references.source: app/stream name pushed to us, e.g. live/venue1
references.destination: RTMP URL or app/stream, e.g. live/cdn-a

references.label: HTTP origin / CDN (HLS, DASH, CMAF)
references.source: playlist or manifest URL, e.g. https://origin.example/live/ch1.m3u8
references.destination: origin or CDN ingest point, e.g. cdn-origin-a

references.label: MoQ stream
references.source: stream name the source publishes under, e.g. cam-1

categories.name: Acquisition
categories.description: Getting media into the facility: receiving live streams, decoding contribution feeds, and aligning sources in time.

categories.name: Distribution
categories.description: Getting media out of the facility to its audiences and partners: encoding for delivery and onward transport.

categories.name: Production
categories.description: Making the programme: production switching, audio mixing, graphics, replay and playout.

featureSections.name: Common
featureSections.description: Building blocks shared by every kind of module.

featureSections.name: Production switcher
featureSections.description: The functions of a live production switcher: its inputs, its program outputs, and the internal features that need configuring.

featureGroups.name: Input options
featureGroups.description: Built into input blocks; set per instance in the workload designer.

featureGroups.name: Switcher source options
featureGroups.description: Built into every switcher input; set per source.

features.name: SRT input
features.description: Receives one external SRT stream (a video feed with its audio/ANC, or an audio-only feed).

schema.title: SRT session
schema.description: Defines the SRT connection itself. Supplied here and injected into the media function by the orchestrator. Shared settings first, then each path's own connection.

streamId.title: Stream ID
streamId.description: Optional; used for multiplexing or identification.

mtu.title: MTU
mtu.description: Usually left at the default unless the path requires otherwise.

port.title: Port
port.description: Local listen port (Listener) or remote port (Caller / Rendezvous).

remoteAddress.title: Remote address
remoteAddress.description: IP or hostname of the remote party (Caller / Rendezvous).

features.name: ZIXI input
features.description: Receives one external ZIXI stream (a video feed with its audio/ANC, or an audio-only feed).

features.name: RIST input
features.description: Receives one external RIST stream (a video feed with its audio/ANC, or an audio-only feed).

features.name: 2022-7 input
features.description: Receives one external 2022-7 stream (a video feed with its audio/ANC, or an audio-only feed).

features.name: RTP input
features.description: Receives one external RTP stream (a video feed with its audio/ANC, or an audio-only feed).

features.name: Raw UDP input
features.description: Receives one external Raw UDP stream (a video feed with its audio/ANC, or an audio-only feed).

features.name: RTMP input
features.description: Receives one external RTMP stream (a video feed with its audio/ANC, or an audio-only feed).

features.name: ST 2110 input
features.description: Receives one SMPTE ST 2110 essence group (a video feed with its audio/ANC, or an audio-only feed). Uncompressed (or lightly compressed) media, so no decoder is needed.

features.name: ST 2022-6 input
features.description: Receives one SMPTE ST 2022-6 stream (SDI over IP, uncompressed) (a video feed with its audio/ANC, or an audio-only feed). No decoder is needed.

features.name: NDI input
features.description: Receives one NDI source (a video feed with its audio/ANC, or an audio-only feed), delivered as media.

features.name: TSoIP input
features.description: Receives one MPEG transport stream over IP (UDP or RTP) (a video feed with its audio/ANC, or an audio-only feed).

features.name: HLS input
features.description: Pulls one HLS stream from an origin (a video feed with its audio/ANC, or an audio-only feed).

features.name: RTMPS input
features.description: Receives one RTMP-over-TLS stream (a video feed with its audio/ANC, or an audio-only feed).

features.name: MXL input
features.description: Reads media from MXL flows inside the facility (video, audio and ANC for a video feed; audio only for an audio feed). Starts the chain of an output or processing module.

features.name: Bonding
features.description: SRT connection bonding: a second path (B) with its own port and remote address; broadcast or main-backup, chosen per instance. Adds a second input to the node when on.

bonding.title: Bonding
bonding.description: Two SRT connections over independent paths (SRT connection bonding). broadcast: both carry the stream, the first good packet wins (seamless, 2022-7 style); main-backup: path B takes over if path A fails. Shared session settings apply to both paths.

port.title: Port
port.description: Local listen port (Listener) or remote port (Caller / Rendezvous).

remoteAddress.title: Remote address
remoteAddress.description: IP or hostname of the remote party (Caller / Rendezvous).

features.name: Network constraints
features.description: For the orchestrator: exposure and, per path, the network, zone and VLAN the stream arrives on.

schema.title: Network constraints
schema.description: Lets the orchestrator place, size, deploy and connect the receiver correctly (recommended).

network.title: Network
network.description: Logical network the stream arrives on, e.g. contribution.

pathB.title: Path B network

network.title: Network
network.description: Logical network the stream arrives on, e.g. contribution.

pathB.description: Should be independent of path A (e.g. a different network or zone).

features.name: Expected payload
features.description: What the incoming stream carries, per path: bitrate (required), container and codecs.

schema.title: Expected payload
schema.description: What the incoming stream carries, per path. The receiver decodes and normalizes it to the output format below; the orchestrator uses the bitrate to reserve bandwidth.

bitrateMbps.title: Bitrate (Mbit/s)
bitrateMbps.description: Bitrate of the incoming stream (including audio and container overhead). Sizes SRT buffers/overhead and the orchestrator's bandwidth reservation.

bitrateMbps.title: Bitrate (Mbit/s)
bitrateMbps.description: Bitrate of the incoming stream (including audio and container overhead). Sizes SRT buffers/overhead and the orchestrator's bandwidth reservation.

features.name: Decoder
features.description: Decodes the incoming stream into media. Attach the codecs this product can decode.

needsAddon.message: A decoder needs at least one codec

features.name: Encoder
features.description: Encodes media into a compressed stream for delivery. Attach the codecs this product can encode.

needsAddon.message: An encoder needs at least one codec

features.name: MXL output
features.description: Publishes decoded media as MXL flows (video, audio and ANC for a video feed; audio only for an audio feed), normalized to the output format below.

video.title: Output video format
video.description: Format the receiver normalizes to; becomes the MXL video flow definition.

audio.title: Output audio
audio.description: Channel count published on the audio flow.

features.name: TSoIP output
features.description: Sends the stream as an MPEG transport stream over IP (UDP or RTP).

features.name: MBTS output
features.description: Sends a multi-bitrate transport stream (the renditions of an ABR ladder in one TS).

features.name: SRT output
features.description: Sends the stream over SRT.

features.name: RIST output
features.description: Sends the stream over RIST.

features.name: ZIXI output
features.description: Sends the stream over ZIXI.

features.name: RTMPS output
features.description: Pushes the stream over RTMP with TLS (e.g. to a streaming platform).

features.name: HLS output
features.description: Packages the stream as HLS for an origin or CDN.

features.name: DASH output
features.description: Packages the stream as MPEG-DASH for an origin or CDN.

features.name: CMAF output
features.description: Packages the stream as CMAF (shared HLS/DASH segments) for an origin or CDN.

features.name: ATSC 3.0 output
features.description: Packages the stream for ATSC 3.0 broadcast (ROUTE/DASH or MMT).

features.name: Latency budget
features.description: Maximum delay through the module; the orchestrator sizes buffers within it.

maxLatencyMs.title: Latency budget (ms)
maxLatencyMs.description: Maximum delay from stream arrival to published grain; the orchestrator sizes buffers within it.

features.name: H.264
features.description: H.264 (video) codec support (decode or encode, on the block it is attached to).

features.name: HEVC
features.description: HEVC (video) codec support (decode or encode, on the block it is attached to).

features.name: JPEG XS
features.description: JPEG XS (video) codec support (decode or encode, on the block it is attached to).

features.name: JPEG 2000
features.description: JPEG 2000 (video) codec support (decode or encode, on the block it is attached to).

features.name: AV1
features.description: AV1 (video) codec support (decode or encode, on the block it is attached to).

features.name: Uncompressed
features.description: Uncompressed (video) codec support (decode or encode, on the block it is attached to).

features.name: AAC
features.description: AAC (audio) codec support (decode or encode, on the block it is attached to).

features.name: MPEG-1 Layer II
features.description: MPEG-1 Layer II (audio) codec support (decode or encode, on the block it is attached to).

features.name: AC-3
features.description: AC-3 (audio) codec support (decode or encode, on the block it is attached to).

features.name: E-AC-3
features.description: E-AC-3 (audio) codec support (decode or encode, on the block it is attached to).

features.name: Opus
features.description: Opus (audio) codec support (decode or encode, on the block it is attached to).

features.name: PCM
features.description: PCM (audio) codec support (decode or encode, on the block it is attached to).

features.name: SRT source
features.description: A camera, encoder or remote switcher arriving over SRT. Listener: it pushes to the switcher's SRT listener and is told apart by its stream ID. Caller: the switcher pulls from its address. Any codec FFmpeg decodes; decoded continuously so cuts are instant.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Listener: the source pushes to us. Caller: we pull from the source.

address.title: Source address
address.description: host:port of the source to pull from.

streamId.title: Stream ID
streamId.description: Identifies this source on the shared listener (listener) or is sent to the source (caller).

features.name: MoQ source
features.description: An H.264 source published to the switcher over Media over QUIC (WebTransport), e.g. from a browser or a Prism ingest.

features.name: MXL source
features.description: Uncompressed media from another function in the facility over MXL shared memory (V210 video, float32 audio, optional data flow with SCTE-104). Skips decoding entirely. The flows come from the workload wiring.

features.name: ST 2110 receiver
features.description: An SMPTE ST 2110 essence group (-20 video, -30 audio, -40 ANC), connected through NMOS IS-04/IS-05 and timed by PTP. The orchestrator assigns the network interface, PTP and NMOS connections.

features.name: Source setup
features.description: Per-source setup: label, multiview position, alignment delay.

position.title: Multiview position
position.description: Order on the multiview; empty = in the order sources are added.

delayMs.title: Alignment delay (ms)
delayMs.description: Delays this source's video and audio to line it up with the others.

features.name: Audio channel
features.description: The source's mixer channel: trim, audio-follow-video, delay, high-pass, gate, 3-band EQ, compressor.

afv.title: Audio follows video
afv.description: Cutting to this source un-mutes it.

delayMs.title: Audio delay (ms)
delayMs.description: Lip-sync correction, on top of the source's alignment delay.

features.name: Upstream key
features.description: A chroma, luma or neural key on this source, composited onto the programme.

fillSource.title: Fill source
fillSource.description: Label of the source giving the fill; empty = this source.

features.name: SRT program output
features.description: Sends the encoded programme (MPEG-TS) to an SRT destination, as caller (push) or listener (pull). Scale out for several destinations; each can keep or strip SCTE-35.

requires.message: needs a program encoder (add Program encoder)

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Caller: we push to the destination. Listener: the destination pulls from us.

features.name: RTMP program output
features.description: Pushes the programme to an RTMP(S) ingest, e.g. a streaming platform.

requires.message: needs a program encoder (add Program encoder)

url.title: Ingest URL
url.description: rtmp:// or rtmps:// URL of the ingest.

features.name: MXL program output
features.description: Publishes the programme uncompressed on MXL (V210 video, float32 audio, VANC data with captions and SCTE-104) in the programme format.

features.name: ST 2110 program output
features.description: Sends the programme as an SMPTE ST 2110 essence group, registered with NMOS.

features.name: Program recording
features.description: Records the encoded programme as MPEG-TS files with time and size rotation. Bind a storage dependency on the instance for where the files go.

requires.message: needs a program encoder (add Program encoder)

features.name: Switching engine
features.description: Programme / preview switching: cut, auto transition, T-bar, hot-punch, fade to black. Every source is decoded continuously into the programme format; a frame synchronizer aligns sources of different rates.

frameSync.title: Frame synchronizer
frameSync.description: freerun: smooth output on its own clock; source-driven: lower latency.

frameRateConversion.title: Frame-rate conversion
frameRateConversion.description: For sources at another rate; mcfi = motion-compensated.

features.name: Transitions
features.description: Mix, dip, wipe (6 directions, soft edge), stinger (PNG sequence + audio) and fade to black, with easing curves. Operated live; nothing to set up.

features.name: Audio mixer
features.description: Per-source channels (set on each source) into a master bus with limiter and BS.1770-4 loudness metering. Faders and mutes are operated live.

features.name: Keyers & DVE
features.description: Upstream chroma and luma keys per source; picture-in-picture, side-by-side and quad layouts. Operated live.

features.name: Downstream graphics
features.description: 8-layer downstream keyer with HTML graphics templates (rendered by a browser sidecar) and animations. Operated live.

features.name: Colour grading
features.description: 3D LUT looks (.cube import) on the programme. Operated live.

features.name: Lens correction & effects
features.description: ST map warps per source or on the programme: barrel/pincushion/fisheye correction, corner pin, animated effects. Operated live.

features.name: Program encoder
features.description: Encodes the programme for SRT, RTMP and recording. Hardware encoders are used when the host has them. Attach the codecs it produces.

needsAddon.message: choose the programme codecs (e.g. H.264 or HEVC, and AAC)

features.name: Closed captions
features.description: CEA-608/708 captions on the programme: pass through the source's, or author them live. Embedded in H.264/HEVC (SEI) and in MXL VANC (ST 334).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: passthrough: keep the selected source's captions; author: typed live or from speech-to-text.

features.name: SCTE-35 ad insertion
features.description: Ad-break cues in the programme TS, with signal conditioning rules per destination.

features.name: Instant replay
features.description: Per-source replay buffers with mark in/out and slow motion down to 0.25× (frame interpolation, pitch-preserved audio). Played back as a virtual source.

shutterAngle.title: Slow-motion shutter angle (°)
shutterAngle.description: Motion blur on slow motion; higher = more blur.

features.name: Clip players
features.description: Four clip players (MPEG-TS, MP4, MOV) appearing as virtual sources. Bind a storage dependency on the instance for the clip library.

features.name: Playout channels
features.description: Two playlist channels (clips, live, slates) with commercial-break pods and SCTE-35, appearing as virtual sources.

features.name: AI background removal
features.description: Removes the background behind people without a green screen. Needs an NVIDIA GPU (TensorRT): declare one in the instance's resource profile.

features.name: Operator comms
features.description: Party-line voice between up to six operators (N-1 mix, push-to-talk, ducks programme audio). Operated live.

features.name: Control room
features.description: The browser control surface: multiview, preview/program, mixer, macros and presets, for director, audio, graphics and viewer roles. Operators reach it over WebTransport.

apiToken.title: API token
apiToken.description: Empty: one is generated at start.

features.name: AI speech-to-text
features.description: Live transcription feeding the captions (Parakeet or Whisper; GPU-accelerated when available).

model.title: Model
model.description: e.g. large-v3-turbo (Whisper); empty = the engine's default.

features.name: SCTE-104 on MXL
features.description: Reads and writes SCTE-104 automation messages on MXL data flows, translated to and from SCTE-35.

requires.message: needs an MXL source or MXL program output
